The '''StarBurn 4''' was a type of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].

==Description==
The StarBurn 4 was manufactured by [[Suwantek Systems]] and it was used in their [[TL-1800 transport|TL-1800 freighter]]. The hyperdrive was considered reliable and only required maintenance once every [[Standard year/Legends|standard year]].
